name: AI Engineering
description: The core craft of building on top of language models: how they work, how you prompt them, how you ground them in your own data, and how you know whether the output is any good.

name: Agentic Systems
description: Everything that turns a model into a system that acts: planning loops, tool calling, memory, multi-agent orchestration, MCP, and the frameworks that package it all up.

name: Production AI
tagline: Ship it and keep it alive
description: What separates a demo from a product: system design, deployment and observability, cost control, safety guardrails, and the Azure AI services you compose it from.

name: Software & Cloud
description: The general engineering interview that still decides most loops: language depth in .NET, Java and Python, frontend work, Azure platform services, and migration strategy.

name: Leadership & Signal
description: The rounds that are not about code: STAR stories, people and org leadership, and the scope, influence and technical-strategy signal expected at Staff and above.
